Marketplace research: Tokopedia vs Shopee
ItemTokopediaShopee
Target marketFocused on IndonesiaIndonesia and Southeast Asia
PopularityPopular with local usersVery popular, driven by aggressive promotions
User interfaceSimple and user-friendlyInteractive, with animations and gamification
DiscountsAvailable, less aggressiveFrequent discounts and daily flash sales
Free shippingAvailable with conditionsMore frequent, often no minimum purchase
Live streamingAvailable (Tokopedia Play)More active and widely used by sellers
PaymentOVO, bank transfer, credit cardShopeePay, COD, bank transfer, credit card
Cash on deliveryLimited quotaWidely available for most products
StrengthsStable for large transactions; many trusted local sellersMany promotions; gamification attracts users
WeaknessesLimited COD; fewer promotionsToo many notifications; product quality varies
